name: Session Zero
description: Generator realm: Architect authors Realm template bundles; Genesis produces hydration payloads for imported templates.
notes: Both members are privileged so either can read the other's private workspace in-realm (/agents/<id>/...). The publishing authorities are declared per agent and stay inert until the operator approves them per agent in the mandatory launch review; privilege alone never grants them.

inputs.label: Assignment
inputs.help: What to author (Architect) or hydrate (Genesis): the experience, its audience, and any must-haves.

inputs.label: Target template id
inputs.help: The template id Genesis must hydrate. Leave empty when Architect is authoring a new bundle; Genesis then reads the newest note under /global/handoff/.

inputs.label: Handoff notes
inputs.help: Optional operator notes written to /global/handoff/notes.md at launch; absent notes write nothing.
inputs.brief: Optional operator notes for this generation session (attached at launch; absent notes are skipped).
